title: Adapted hBCS and stroke and mortality transitions: research code
description: Research-code archive for longitudinal adapted harmonized Brain Care Score analyses of HRS and CHARLS. Includes the existing core and additional-analysis scripts, an analysis-coverage map, input documentation, and an MIT license. No participant-level data are included. This is a source-code archive rather than a validated one-command reproduction pipeline; module coverage and historical execution dependencies are documented in the repository. Death-reclassification and full complete-score selection-weighting analyses are outside the scope of this release.
